title: Peanut Butter and Chocolate Chunk Ice Cream (No Egg)
changes_from_base: Peanut butter replaces the strawberries in the base, with homemade peanut-chocolate chunks folded through.
summary: Creamy peanut butter ice cream with thin, snappy chunks of homemade peanut-chocolate, made in a churn without eggs.
equipment: small tray lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Peanut base
steps.text: Warm the milk, sugar, syrup and salt in the saucepan until the sugar has dissolved, then take off the heat and whisk in the 130 g peanut butter until completely smooth.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Whisk in the cold cream and chill for at least 4 h. Peanut butter thickens the base, so whisk again before churning.

steps.title: Make the chunks
steps.text: Melt the milk chocolate in the heatproof bowl over barely simmering water, stir in the 40 g peanut butter and spread thinly on the lined tray. Freeze until hard, then chop into small chunks.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn the peanut base for 20-25 min, until thick.

steps.title: Fold and freeze
steps.text: Fold through the frozen chunks, pack into the container and freeze, covered, for at least 4 h.

tips: Use a smooth peanut butter without added palm oil for the cleanest flavour.
Spread the chocolate thinly so the chunks stay tender, not hard, in the ice cream.
Add a handful of chopped roasted peanuts for extra crunch.
storage: Keep covered with baking paper pressed on the surface in the freezer for up to 2 weeks. Soften for 10 min in the fridge before scooping.
